expected_replacements.proposed_complete_clause_text: DRAFT: For forward and retained recovery operations, the external controller serializes admission against the original issuer policy and known scoped revocation. A request irreversibly closes new admissions in its affected scope; a previously admitted operation may complete only its predeclared finite effects and descendants up to its independently known safe cut, inside the original fixed deadline, already-spent budget and exact object/effect scope. This explicitly allows internal effects after an applicable forward or recovery/all revocation request. Worker and contained commands retain no service/broker/control channel. Actual admission-to-effect serialization, no-channel enforcement and safe stopping are unresolved.

DRAFT: Unknown/lost/stale admission result, unknown revocation scope, clock/identity/containment/envelope or spend closes new admission and denies dependent unproved effects; already in-flight outcomes remain pending until independently known. No uncertain request becomes no-effect or safe drain. Original consumed claim, launch slot and recovery budget never reopen. No retry/replay/refund/relaunch/rebind/reacquisition/renewal/new grant follows.

DRAFT: Independently authenticate the original consumed attempt, exact forward operation/effect/descendant scope, original fixed trusted boot/time bounds and durable spend before one serialized operation admission. Require reviewed containment of its entire finite envelope through its known safe cut. Forward revocation closes further admissions rather than requiring fresh revocation permission at every internal effect of an already admitted operation. Identity/time/scope/guard/known-control conditions remain continuously required. A poll/reply/lease/operation label is not native serialization or a safe cut.

DRAFT: Forward revocation irreversibly closes further forward admission. Already admitted operations may complete only the specifically declared finite envelope under original valid bounds;this is an explicit exception to the current no-new-effect-dispatch reading after revocation,not a deadline/failure exemption. Expiry,scope failure,unknown control or envelope cannot authorize additional unproved effects. Original failure and all in-flight obligations persist. No renewed admission,slot,deadline,budget or right is introduced.

DRAFT: Before admission enumerate all actual internal effects,objects,writers,FDs,helpers,descendants,streams,async storage and a finite independently supported safe cut. Loss/stop requests,backend return,task counts or a named boundary do not establish completion. If expiry/failure/owner loss arrives before known stopping,deny unproved dependent effects and retain actual in-flight/child obligations pending;never claim guaranteed finite drain or closure.

DRAFT: Use only the explicitly retained original same-attempt recovery scope,fixed finite deadline and durable once-only action budget,with every original trap/guard/identity/known-backup/drain prerequisite. Serialize one pre-spent recovery operation admission against known original recovery/all revocation. Once admitted,only its exact declared finite recovery envelope may finish within original bounds after an applicable revocation request. This changes the current live recovery fence at every internal effect;no blanket expiry exemption or foreign restore is granted.

DRAFT: A known recovery/all revocation request denies subsequent recovery operation admission irreversibly. A known pre-request admitted recovery operation may complete only its predeclared finite envelope and known safe cut inside its unchanged original deadline/budget/safe identity;post-request internal writes are an explicit weakened guarantee. Unknown scope,boot/clock/identity/control drift or expiry denies unproved effects and preserves pending obligations. Forward-only revocation does not revoke separately retained recovery. No replacement right or replay follows.

DRAFT: After independently known target closure,use captured closed data only under separately reviewed original publication controls. Publication operation admission and its own known revocation policy,source/observer/writer/storage/custody/finite bounds must be independently specified;target forward/recovery rights or requests cannot be borrowed as publication authority. Its own applicable revocation may deny new admissions while a specifically pre-admitted finite envelope finishes within its separate original bounds. All terminal receipt/observer/custody guarantees and exact stage membership remain unresolved for405/407;no late target/source action or republish on uncertainty.

additional_joint_guarantee_losses: Forward internal effects after a scoped request would be permitted inside an already admitted finite envelope;current every-effect validity/no-new-effect revocation is weakened.

Recovery/internal target-evidence writes after a recovery/all request would also be permitted only inside a known pre-admitted finite original envelope. This is an additional explicit replacement of original323 recovery validity/revocation,not unchanged recovery equivalence.

Publication has its own independent original controls and revocation policy;proposed pre-admitted continuation would change its instantaneous internal-effect boundary if adopted. Complete405/407 terminal criteria remain due,not assumed equivalent.
No actual cut latency,stopping deadline,known drain,external no-channel serialization or complete compatible effect graph is established;paper timing does not provide them.

irreversible pre-spend of original single launch and each finite action budget
all exact internal effects and allowed descendants,not three calls
known protected original baseline and exact backups before applicable mutation
known continuous original guards and independently safe containment
scope-specific complete original expected/raw effect and failure vectors
separate actual source/trust/oracle/control/custody for both platforms
